subject: Renewal health: token cadence, perf regressions, and staged uplift proposal
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Liam Patel <liam.patel@novusai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal health: token cadence, perf regressions, and staged uplift proposal

Hi Liam —

Hope you're well. As we approach the November renewal window I wanted to surface a concise view of NovusAI's usage health and propose a low-friction staged uplift to avoid capacity crunches while addressing recent perf regressions. Summary below, attached ROI workbook and Q3 perf readout.

Quick summary (what we see):
- Token cadence: Average monthly token spend has increased ~38% QoQ; weekly peaks now hit 1.6x prior ceiling during product demos.
- Cost mix: 62% of tokens are long-sequence API calls (>1,000 tokens) against the hallucination-sensitive model variant.
- Performance: Median p95 latency increased from 420ms -> 640ms after the August runtime update for long-sequence requests. Our perf readout (attached) correlates this with model KV cache fragmentation on heavier sessions.
- Business impact: Slower responses are affecting demo conversion and the embed pipeline retry rate has increased ~7%, costing engineering cycles.

Proposed safety-first uplift (3-phase staged approach):
1) Immediate (30-day): +20% Dedicated capacity (reserve) with a 30% burst credit pool to absorb peak demos. Temporary allotment; cost delta modeled in ROI workbook.
2) Pilot (60–90 days): Route 25% of long-sequence requests to a quantized variant (same quality guardrails) and measure quality/latency delta.
3) Renewal term: Convert to a stepped commit that starts at +10% baseline capacity with predefined step-ups tied to usage thresholds (we can cap monthly escalation).

Ask: Can we schedule a 30-min sync this week to walk the ROI workbook and pick the initial uplift window? If you prefer, Marissa and I can propose precise calendar slots.

Attachments: RI_renewal_ROI_20261002.xlsx, perf_readout_q3_2026.pdf

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
d: (415) 555-0132 | diego_fernandez@redwood.com

On behalf of: Redwood Inference — Production-grade inference for predictable LLM economics
From: Liam Patel <liam.patel@novusai.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Nguyen <sara@novusai.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal health: token cadence, perf regressions, and staged uplift proposal

Diego —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few immediate questions from our side:
- The latency bump: is that primarily the model runtime change on Redwood's side or something in our prompt patterns? We run fairly long-context RAG flows.
- Cost projection: can you share a cost-per-1M-token for the proposed +20% uplift and the pilot routing? Sara (cc) wants a straightforward delta so she can take this to finance.
- Quality: we are cautious about shifting any production traffic to a quantized variant without a short A/B showing zero-quality regressions for our top-10 intents.

We like the staged approach but would prefer the uplift to be reversible quickly if we see regressions. Also — FYI — we have an internal evaluation of the embed pipeline that may change token mix in mid-November; we need the uplift window to be flexible.

Best,
Liam
VP Product, NovusAI
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Proposed negotiation posture for NovusAI renewal uplift

Team — internal notes for Diego/Marissa before call with Liam:

Context we should bring:
- Estimated uplift economics (30-day +20%): incremental cost to NovusAI = ~$7.8k/mo at list rate; with a 10% commit discount we can show ~$6.9k/mo. See ROI tab in attached workbook.
- Operational mitigations: auto-fallback to a slightly cheaper model variant for non-demo traffic and a 48-hour rollback SLA if quality dips.
- Negotiation levers: 6–9 month stepped commit, 4% additional discount for a 12-month mid-term extension, 60% of burst credits applied for the first 90 days.

Technical asks for Novus:
- A short prompt set (top-10 intents) they can share for a quantized pilot (we've successfully validated on similar workloads with <1% metric delta).
- Permission to run a short AB test routing 10% of sessions to the quantized binary during the pilot window.

Proposed next steps (for call):
1) Walk ROI workbook (5–7 mins)
2) Align on rollback SLA and pilot gating metrics (quality/latency thresholds)
3) Agree on a 30-day provisional uplift window (date window options: Oct 12–Nov 12 or Oct 19–Nov 19)

I'll pull the econ numbers into a single slide for the call.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Liam / Sara —

Thanks for the quick responses and the context. Two quick items before we lock a time:

1) Root cause: Our infra and runtime teams confirm the p95 shift is tied to the August kernel selection change that affects long KV cache churn on sequences >1k tokens. We've prioritized a patch but it will not fully eliminate peaks for a few weeks. The uplift is a hedge while we finalize the runtime fix.

2) Cost projection & ROI highlights: Attached is the ROI workbook (RI_renewal_ROI_20261002.xlsx) and a one-page readout of the perf data (perf_readout_q3_2026.pdf). Top-line:
   - +20% provisional capacity adds ~1.2M tokens of headroom monthly. At your current token mix and our committed rate, this maps to ~$7.8k/mo list impact; with a one-time 6% renewal discount we can get to ~$7.3k/mo.
   - Pilot routing (25% long-seq to quantized) shows projected token-cost savings of ~14% in the pilot cohort assuming no quality delta. We'll instrument evaluation hooks for the top-10 intents (Monica will coordinate).

Proposed meeting slots (PT):
- Tue Oct 5, 10:30–11:00
- Wed Oct 6, 13:00–13:30
- Thu Oct 7, 16:00–16:30

If one of those works, we'll lock it and share the short agenda. If you prefer a written approval path, a quick reply saying 'Approve provisional +20% Oct12–Nov12 with pilot gating' will suffice and we'll issue a provisional addendum for signature.

Appreciate the partnership — we want to avoid a reactive scale event during your demo season.

Best,
Diego
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
